rv.q: It’s the most fun you’re likely to have with experimental theater this season.
Pony Cam ultimately undercuts their collective’s originality with an unnecessary post-script performance, but still, Burnout Paradise is one of the best nights out this fall.

rv.q: Perhaps the best thing about Burnout Paradise is the way it makes a collective of its entire audience.
